contract: Every discovered candidate-bearing source is hash-pinned and classified. UI is never an enforcement point.

Central fail-closed local decision plus bounded Memory eligibility for raw identities.
RS256 service scopes, timeout/body bounds, schema validation and no error-body logging.
Advisory-lock idempotency, append-only local/remote lifecycle events plus CAS projection, body-free leased outbox, missing-directive refusal and atomic cursor/snapshot transactions.
Bounded delivery before feed poll; reconciliation replaces no active generation until the transaction commits.
Verified candidate plus recent auth or super-admin evidence UUID; intake flag precedes body-dependent lookup.

Five attempts per fifteen minutes with a constant failure handler.

Application-correlated SQL fence precedes shortlist, feedback and aggregate reads/writes.

Checks after load, before GCS/model and before score/summary publication; restriction releases credit and settles without charge.
Anchor checks after load, before GCS/ActiveKG calls and immediately before node/edge publication.

Results enter Flow only through the batch-filtered sourcing-sync materializer; contact calls are made only by fenced callers.
Existing issuer/subject/audience signer mints only caller-selected read/write scope.
Known application IDs arrive only after route/worker load fences; final publication repeats the fence and releases restricted reservations.

Bounce/complaint hygiene only creates restrictive suppression evidence and never returns a candidate profile.

Application aggregates only decide whether a job row may be archived; no candidate data or candidate count is returned or published.
The sole admin caller is fail-closed in 1AF; this legacy helper is unreachable and may not be revived without a per-row privacy contract.
Organization pipeline-integrity repair retains and rewrites stage/history foreign keys without presenting profile, resume or contact data.
Pure restrictive suppression and cancellation helpers cannot create or expose a candidate profile.
Authenticated provider bounce/complaint/unsubscribe events only add restrictive delivery/suppression state.
Read-only exact schema/catalog verification returns no candidate product row.
Forward schema definition and zero-row DDL only; it contains no candidate-data deletion or retention action.
